item.title: Claude Opus 4.8 is now available in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Azure NetApp Files for EDA workloads: From revolution to breakthrough at scale
item.description:
Azure NetApp Files is redefining what’s possible for EDA in the cloud—delivering scalable, high-performance storage that supports massive concurrency, low latency, and consistent production performance. With independent benchmark validation and real-world adoption, organizations can now run EDA workloads at scale without traditional storage bottlenecks.

The post Azure NetApp Files for EDA workloads: From revolution to breakthrough at scale appeared first on Microsoft Azure Blog.

item.title: Azure IaaS: Deploy high-performance workloads with a system-level approach
item.description:
Performance in the cloud is no longer defined by individual resources—it’s shaped by how compute, storage, and networking work together. Azure IaaS takes a system-level approach to help organizations achieve consistent, scalable performance across AI, cloud-native, and business-critical workloads.

The post Azure IaaS: Deploy high-performance workloads with a system-level approach appeared first on Microsoft Azure Blog.

item.title: Azure Files Entra-Only identities: Advancing cloud-native identity and security
item.description:
We are excited to announce the general availability (GA) of Entra-Only identities for Azure Files SMB. With native Microsoft Entra ID authentication, organizations can now grant secure, identity-based access to SMB file shares using cloud-native-only identities.

The post Azure Files Entra-Only identities: Advancing cloud-native identity and security appeared first on Microsoft Azure Blog.

item.title: From commit to cloud: Powering what’s next for PostgreSQL
item.description:
PostgreSQL has become foundational to how modern applications are built. It powers everything from early‑stage startups to some of the most demanding production systems in the world. Its longevity isn’t accidental, it’s the result of decades of engineering discipline, community collaboration, and a relentless focus on correctness and extensibility.

The post From commit to cloud: Powering what’s next for PostgreSQL appeared first on Microsoft Azure Blog.
